name: Natalie Epstein
office: Saugus Union School District, Governing Board Member, Trustee Area No. 1

items.text: Natalie Epstein is a small-business owner and parent in the Saugus Union School District. She says she has been a room parent and PTA member in the district. She decided to run after a safety incident in which a student left an elementary school campus and was found over a mile away before district staff knew they were missing. She says she wants to improve campus safety, support teachers, listen to families, and ensure responsible spending. She opposes making Proposition 3’s tax permanent without first improving accountability and transparency for existing taxpayer dollars.
